summary: The blueprint covers the major human pancreatic compartments but needs targeted refinements for stromal, neural, myeloid, and ductal heterogeneity.

issues.description: The stromal compartment is dominated by fibroblast/ECM markers, while pericytes and vascular smooth muscle are combined in one module. Pancreatic stellate/fibroblast-like cells, pericytes, and smooth muscle cells are expected in human pancreas but are not cleanly separable.
issues.suggested_fix: Refine the stromal branch with a broad mesenchymal gate and distinct axes/modules for pancreatic stellate/fibroblast/ECM cells, pericytes, and vascular smooth muscle where supported. Reduce overlap between stromal_core and fibroblast_matrix so the gate is not essentially a duplicate fibroblast program.

issues.description: The neural module is mostly Schwann/glial markers with only weak neuronal/ganglionic representation, so autonomic neuronal or ganglionic cells may be missed or collapsed into a glial score.
issues.suggested_fix: Either rename/refocus the current module as Schwann/glial and add a separate neuronal/ganglionic module/axis using canonical neuronal/autonomic markers, or add a gated neural contrast separating glial from neuronal/ganglionic identity.

issues.description: The macrophage module is resident/tissue macrophage-like and dendritic_apc is a broad composite of cDC1, cDC2, and pDC markers. Monocytes and finer dendritic/APC states expected in pancreas atlases are not represented separately.
issues.suggested_fix: Add a monocyte/myeloid-inflammatory axis under immune_core if supported. If dimensionality allows, split dendritic_apc into cDC and pDC modules rather than one mixed APC axis.

issues.description: The ductal module mixes canonical duct markers with remodeling or activated duct-associated genes such as SPP1 and MMP7, and there is no ductal sub-axis for centroacinar/terminal duct or activated/secretory duct states.
issues.suggested_fix: Keep the broad ductal axis, but add one gated ductal refinement if literature support is available, such as canonical/CFTR-high duct versus SPP1/MMP7-high remodeling duct, or a centroacinar/terminal duct program.

out_of_scope: I did not verify paper, atlas, or database citation handles; this review is limited to biological coverage and marker plausibility.
